name: Music
description: Spotify-style player for your NAS: search and stream from YouTube, a downloaded library, playlists, likes, radio stations and podcasts, all shared with the EthOS Music Android app. The music API stays in EthOS so the phone keeps working; this package ships the desktop app. Install “Music Engine” for search, streaming and downloads.
author: SyncHot
changelog: 1.0.3: stable data-testid hooks on the bottom nav, mini player and full player, so the EthOS QA sweep can drive the window. No behaviour change. 1.0.2: share playlists with other accounts — a sharing card in Settings, a “Shared with me” section and read-only playlist playback (requires EthOS 2.13.3). 1.0.1: light and dark themes follow the EthOS toggle; feedback now goes to the global Notification Center instead of a package toast; downloads report progress in the shared task panel. 1.0.0: first release. The Music desktop app moves out of the core install; it requires the Music Engine package, which Package Center installs automatically. Your library, likes, playlists and podcast subscriptions stay in EthOS and remain shared with the Android app.
